entities.name: Ayara
entities.description: Ancient elf queen of the court of Locthwain on Eldraine, compleated and then slain.

entities.description: Cauldron sought by Locthwain champions that kept Ayara youthful.

entities.name: Rankle

events.summary: Ayara stays as ruler of Locthwain rather than withdrawing with her kin into the Wilds.
